tasting_notes: Danish cherry liqueur made since 1818 from Danish-grown cherries; rich, dark, gently spiced cherry. Purveyor to the Royal Danish Court.
Danish stomach bitter created 1964 from 29 herbs, spices and flowers; dry, aromatic and bracingly bitter.
Sweeter, less-bitter expression launched 2019 with higher honey and licorice content.
Licorice-and-chili flavoured shooter variant of Gammel Dansk.
Danish black-licorice liqueur descended from the 1930s throat-lozenge brand; intense salty-sweet licorice.
Hotter, sweeter licorice variant of the Ga-Jol liqueur range.
Chocolate-licorice variant of the Ga-Jol liqueur range.
Smoky Pasilla Mixe chilli from Oaxaca with Danish purple wheat and Pilsner malt; earthy, smoky and fruity, with the best fractions rested in Oloroso sherry casks.
Kernel inside plum stones plus distilled marigold kombucha; marzipan, bitter-almond, floral and tannic.
Pilsner malt fermented with Belgian saison yeast, macerated and distilled with lemon leaf, tangerine, fig, coffee, vetiver, ambrette seeds and blackcurrant buds.
Danish juniper berries and juniper wood (smoked over juniper) with Pilsner malt and Belgian saison yeast, rested in ex-Oloroso casks.
